_comment: Spec 38 (Motion System) FR-38-24 bundle-size budget baseline.
These are MEASURED (gzip, bytes) build actuals recorded via --update-baseline — NOT the Spec 38 section 4.4 table (which is an ESTIMATE, see script docstring).

2026-08-24: shared/effects/fx-cursor-field.js re-baselined 1331 -> 1673 gzip (+342 B, +25.7%). DELIBERATE, not drift: the field now arrives and leaves WITH the pointer instead of parking a lit pool in each section's centre and snapping back there on exit (Bean's ruling, 2026-08-24). That needed a mouseenter handler and a visibility toggle. Absolute cost is 342 bytes gzip against a 50KB/page budget. Re-baselined rather than trimmed because the growth buys the behaviour; the gate did its job by making the cost explicit.

2026-08-24: shared/effects/fx-magnet.js baselined at 1054 gzip on first build (FR-38-30, magnetic pull). Tier V, zero dependencies — one rAF-throttled document listener writing two custom properties. For scale: the whole effect is ~2% of the 50KB/page JS budget, and a page using it and no Tier G effect still ships zero GSAP bytes.

2026-08-25: shared/effects/fx-wave-gradient.js baselined at 3648 gzip on first build (FR-38-31, Tier W second entry). Includes the simplex-noise GLSL and the mesh builder. 3% of D479's NAMED 120KB Tier W page allowance; a page not using it ships zero bytes of it, and it carries no GSAP.
